description: Vélos Bleus Nice is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Institut Méditerranéen du Risque de l'Environnement et du Développement Durable. This dataset provides access to the number of bikes available close to Lenval Hospital in Nice. The dataset is dynamic, and following the NGSI-LD standard. It is available through an API provided by Orion-LD. An example is provided here: where the last date should be changed accordingly to reflect the current date. Coverage: Institut Méditerranéen du Risque de l'Environnement et du Développement Durable. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycles Bleus Nice" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Institut Méditerranéen du Risque de l'Environnement et du Développement Durable. Its keywords include shared-bikes, nice, mobility. The listing shows 1 download or service links in NGSI-LD. The listing shows 2023-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
